summary: Master inflation risk and pension plan sustainability. Learn LDI, ALM, and actuarial modeling to protect fund solvency. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Inflation risk in pension plans is the chance that rising prices reduce asset purchasing power while increasing inflation-linked benefit obligations. For pension investment officers, actuaries, trustees and risk managers, this course develops practical approaches to assessing liability sensitivity, valuing inflation-linked bonds, building derivative hedges and modeling funding levels under inflation scenarios.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the financial health and regulatory compliance of retirement funds and long-term investment pools.
modules: Inflation Dynamics and Pension Liability Impact
Actuarial Valuation and Inflation Sensitivity Analysis
Real Asset Allocation for Inflation Protection
Stress Testing and Scenario Modeling for Sustainability
Strategic Sustainability Roadmaps and Stakeholder Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of financial markets and basic actuarial concepts. Familiarity with Excel for financial modeling is required. Prior experience in pension fund administration, investment management, or corporate finance is highly recommended.
